name: OSS_USAGE_REQUESTS_T
description: Following table is used to capture ess job request information.

columns.name: RATING_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture unique identifier of  rating request.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: ROOT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the requested id of ess job, submitted by user.

columns.name: PARENT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the parent requested id associated with the usage rating job.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture ess parameter business unit id.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture ess parameter customer party id.

columns.name: DATE_FROM
columns.description: Field used to capture ess parameter date from.

columns.name: DATE_TO
columns.description: Field used to capture ess parameter date if.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture ess parameter batch id.

columns.name: START_TIME
columns.description: Field used to capture  time of stating of process.

columns.name: END_TIME
columns.description: Field used to capture  time of ending of process.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture subscription id.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_START_DATE_FROM
columns.description: Field used to filter subscription whose start date is on or after the provided value.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_START_DATE_TO
columns.description: Field used to filter subscription whose start date is on or before the provided value.

columns.name: PRODUCT_START_DATE_FROM
columns.description: Field used to filter subscription product whose start date is on or after the provided value.

columns.name: PRODUCT_START_DATE_TO
columns.description: Field used to filter subscription product whose start date is on or before the provided value.

columns.name: BALANCE_REGISTER_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture balance register id.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture inventory item id.

columns.name: EXTEND_ENTITLEMENTS_UNTIL_DATE
columns.description: Field used to capture extend entitlement schedule till date.

columns.name: JOB_NAME
columns.description: Field used to capture requested job name.

columns.name: WORKER_TYPE
columns.description: Field used to capture worker type of ess request..

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Field used to capture request job status.

columns.name: PROCESS_STATUS
columns.description: This field tracks the process status associated with the usage rating job.

columns.name: NEXT_PROCESS
columns.description: This field tracks the next process associated with the usage rating job.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
